dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Smooth concave curvature on the trailing edge, following a parabolic spline from the dorsal insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with an obtuse angle at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear incline approximately 55 degrees relative to the primary longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.6 times the maximum vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex arc with a large pixel radius forming a smooth, rounded forehead profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick pixel representation of the beak, showing a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the descending melon curve meets the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Translucent, iridescent cyan-to-white light-emissive texture across the entire visible surface.
